representation: WorkItem analysis.dominators uses the existing typed sparse BitSet chain: sentinel base -1, then sorted 32-member chunks.
Universal sets are built algorithmically from a member count; tail bits use a shift and complement rather than copied one-bit tables.
Dominator computation intersects every predecessor set, includes the block itself and repeats until equality holds.
Assignment reuses existing chunks and retains the original typed copy_bitset trap for source tails that require allocation.

independent_validation.comparison: all six dominator sentinel/member chains match by signed base and exact 32-bit membership; block/edge order, flags, numbering, expression/tree/symbol fields and label references also match
